svg.title: Raleigh’s Colonisation of Virginia: Roanoke Island, Tiger Grounding and ‘CROATOAN’ (1584–90)
svg.desc: Dual-GIS historical atlas showing on the left a 1:10m coastal map of Raleigh’s Virginia (Chesapeake Bay, Albemarle and Pamlico Sounds, Roanoke Island, Dasamonquepeuc and Secotan, Ocracoke Inlet where the Tiger grounded on 29 June 1585, and Croatoan/Hatteras Island), and on the right a North Atlantic GIS inset charting the Trade-Wind and Spanish Caribbean privateering route alongside the 1588 Armada delay.

text.tspan: 29 Jun 1585: Flagship Tiger Grounded, Corn Ruined

g.text: Outbound via Canaries & Caribbean Trade Winds
Return via Azores • 1588 Armada Blocks Relief to 1590
